bill_payments_live.name: bill_payments_live
bill_payments_live.definition: select "id", "bill_id", "due_date", "paid_date", "amount_minor", "currency", "status", "payment_method", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" from "bill_payments" where ("bill_payments"."deleted_at" is null and exists (select 1 from "bills" where ("bills"."id" = "bill_payments"."bill_id" and "bills"."deleted_at" is null)))
